name: crosspoint
description: A diagram an agent and a human can both edit — a typed graph whose layout the human owns and the agent cannot express.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @crosspoint/core && CROSSPOINT_GRAPH="$PWD/graph.json" concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @crosspoint/server" "npm run dev -w @crosspoint/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @crosspoint/core && npm run build -w @crosspoint/server && npm run build -w @crosspoint/mcp && npm run build -w @crosspoint/web
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test -w @crosspoint/core && npm run test -w @crosspoint/server && npm run test -w @crosspoint/mcp && npm run test -w @crosspoint/e2e
